product_one_liner.value: Fluxco is a transformer-procurement marketplace that helps utilities, data centers, developers and EPC contractors specify equipment, compare bids from global manufacturers, and manage delivery, service and warranty.

pricing_page.notes: No public pricing plans or pricing link found; purchases use project-specific quotes.

named_customers.notes: Only Antora Energy could be substantiated as a named customer; no second customer or qualifying customer directory was found.

employee_band.notes: Reported employee count is 13; mapped to the requested band rather than the broader 11–50 profile category.

eng_blog.notes: The resource index contains procurement guides, transformer explainers and industry content, not posts by engineers explaining how the platform is built.

public_docs.notes: No public documentation/help portal found; the accessible FAQ is a single page, not a multi-article help center.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The open title is Full-Stack Software Engineer (AI-Native Generalist), which explicitly contains AI. It is an AI-assisted software-engineering role, not a dedicated ML or data-science position.

model_provider.notes: The privacy policy mentions AI-assisted specification and quote tools without naming a provider. Claude Code, Cursor and Codex appear as development tools in a job posting, not as disclosed models powering the product; no public product-model or subprocessor disclosure was found.

compliance_certs.notes: The privacy policy describes safeguards but names none of SOC 2, ISO 27001, HIPAA, GDPR or PCI DSS.

last_funding.notes: The founders announced the closed round on July 23, 2026; date uses that announcement rather than later reporting dates.

raised_18mo.notes: The July 23, 2026 seed announcement falls within May 9, 2025–November 9, 2026.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: An Account Executive (Data Centers) position is publicly listed.

launched_6mo.notes: The July 23, 2026 founder announcement explicitly announces launching Fluxco and describes its transformer-bidding and end-to-end procurement platform.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: Brian Tochman’s profile dates the start of his Founder and CEO role to January 2026, within the requested window.

crm_stack_signal.notes: The sales posting refers to an unnamed CRM; the engineering posting names application and transactional-email tools, not a named CRM or sales/marketing platform.
